chunks: And Ibrāhīm al-Karkhī said: I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام
I am able to turn toward the qiblah while in the mahmil.
So he said: “Is this constriction? Do you not have in the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم an example?”

key_terms.أُسْوَةٌ: an example or model to be followed
key_terms.الْمَحْمِلِ: a covered riding carrier or mount used in travel
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: Is it necessary to face the qiblah while praying in a mahmil during travel?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses prayer practice while traveling, specifically facing the qiblah in a mahmil. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام points to the example of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, indicating that hardship and excessive restriction are not intended where the Prophetic sunnah provides guidance.
